checks.result: The exact clean implementation commit passed all 16 foundation commands and all 143 foundation tests. Build provenance reported 0.1.0+g86c386e clean; repository, architecture, approved reference, design-first gate, ADR, CI, quality, packaging, backlog, and generated views all passed.

The desktop profile passed all inherited foundation commands, 7 desktop regressions, approved-reference integrity, exact token and route checks, 14 workflows across 139 distinct-route browser cases, 32-page accessibility and 64 responsive cases, and 64 deterministic light/dark screenshots.

All 12 focused ADR and desktop conformance tests passed, including fixture/application separation, light/dark token drift, supporting navigation, workflow ordering, accessibility, normative failure mapping, and same-reference baseline history laundering denial.
The authoritative ledger validates with 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates; generated planning views have no drift.

evidence: The activated desktop profile validates 109 light/dark semantic tokens, all 32 product routes and required regions, exact approved supporting-tool navigation, all 14 ordered workflow profiles, and previous/next behavior for 139 distinct-route browser cases.

Keyboard focus visibility, keyboard-operated theme and sidebar controls, approved accessible-name behavior, two responsive viewports, and 64 light/dark visual captures pass on the pinned Windows x64 renderer.

The pre-application approved-reference-fixture mode fails when researcher-facing application source appears, so CAP-00 qualifies the verifier without falsely claiming that CAP-01 application code exists.

The activation pins Windows x64, Playwright 1.58.0, Chromium 145.0.7632.6, a 1440x900 viewport, two responsive viewports, device scale, locale, UTC, reduced motion, light/dark schemes, Segoe UI/Georgia/Consolas, animation suppression, deterministic time/random values, and offline asset loading.
The committed baseline binds 64 screenshot SHA-256 values to the exact approved reference ID, package SHA-256, approval commit, and renderer settings.

Full reachable Git-history replay rejects malformed or removed baselines, same-reference or same-approval rewrites, merge/history laundering, dirty or non-HEAD bytes, and changes whose new approval does not follow the prior baseline version.
Every conformance report carries the exact approved reference ID/package and names the governing token, style, route, workflow, page, and approval artifacts.

Reports preserve the approved illustrative exclusions for mock names, studies, sources, providers, counts, dates, prose, chart values, and nonfunctional actions rather than treating them as product requirements.
ADR-0004, architecture protection, quality scope, strict activation schema, CI policy, and the design-first anti-tamper inventory prevent the same change from silently disabling these checks.
